rationale: Evaluating whether required braking is omitted requires characterising braking-maneuver execution itself. SG-1 and FR-7 explicitly establish that behaviour as the evaluation subject, while H-1 supports the obstacle- and road-user-related collision-avoidance context. P remains focused on braking execution; its reference to obstacle-detection/braking scenarios does not incorporate detection mechanisms or their timing into the phenomenon.
determining_elements: “The vehicle's braking-maneuver execution state” identifies the system behaviour directly required to evaluate omission of braking.
The scope limits consideration to driving encounters with obstacles or road users where braking may be required to avoid collision, consistent with H-1 and FR-7.

The reference to related obstacle-detection/braking scenarios provides situational context without adding sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
